assets.name: AEC connected intelligence
assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: high-end editorial website hero artwork for an AI specialist working in architecture, engineering and construction (AEC). A standalone illustration, not a screenshot of a website.
Primary request: Create a sophisticated sculptural 3D still life showing AEC project information becoming connected intelligence. The dominant subject is a beautiful compact connected information system: a few floating ivory technical document sheets with fine drawing grids, a section-detail drawing and small table marks, arranged around an elegant forest-green translucent stack of data layers. Fine copper/terracotta paths connect a few tactile circular nodes and the document layers. Include a small abstract structural column-and-beam wireframe as a subtle cue to engineering data, not an architectural building design. The scene must communicate document retrieval, integrated data, and intelligent tools.
Style: premium physical 3D editorial art direction, tactile matte ceramic and smoked translucent glass, restrained, precise, materially realistic, polished enough for a public professional portfolio. Refined technical composition rather than generic AI clip art.
Composition: portrait 4:5; one cohesive connected arrangement in the middle 65% of the image, concentrated between 22% and 65% image height. Generous calm space at top and bottom. Full-bleed dark forest green studio background. This will sit in the right half of a tablet hero with a curved upper-left crop and a caption overlay near the bottom, so all important subject matter must remain comfortably inside the central area. Slightly elevated three-quarter camera, elegant depth, crisp but not busy. 
Palette: deep forest green #1f4035, warm ivory #f5f3eb, soft sage, muted terracotta #b66449 and tiny brushed-copper accents. Soft warm directional studio light, delicate shadows, subtle atmospheric falloff. Beautiful tonal contrast and fine details.
No readable text, letters, logos, watermark, people, faces, humanoid robots, brains, glowing neon, cyberpunk, cities, homes, picturesque buildings, landscaped architecture, or fake screenshot claims. This is an AI-generated conceptual brand artwork, not a claim of real project output.
assets.finalEditPrompt:
Edit the supplied AI-generated portfolio hero artwork. Preserve its premium physical 3D editorial style, dark forest-green backdrop, ivory documents, central stacked glass intelligence module, copper connecting paths, lighting, and portrait composition. Broaden what it represents: this AI specialist builds AEC image-generation/design tools as well as document retrieval and workflow automation.
Change the RIGHT-HAND group of ivory table/drawing sheets into a compact fan of three sophisticated image-generation output panels connected to the central system. These should visibly contain small coherent high-quality rendered material/space studies: warm timber and daylight in one, a clean sculptural facade detail in one, and a neutral material/lighting variation in one. Make these unmistakably image cards, not text charts. Keep the left technical document and upper engineering detail as retrieval inputs. Replace the small lower-right circular layer symbol with a refined dark-green control panel with three terracotta/ivory slider knobs (no text), linked to the central stack. The whole image should read as one elegant AI tool system combining documents, controls, and generated images. Image outputs are samples inside connected software-tool metaphors, not standalone architectural design services.
Preserve the central arrangement and safe crop margins. Avoid readable text, logos, watermarks, neon, brains, robots, people. Keep the original material realism and restraint.

assets.name: AEC generative workflows
assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: editorial campaign artwork for a portfolio section headed "Turning AI potential into practice". A standalone image, not a screenshot of a web page.
Primary request: Illustrate a practical AI automation workflow for architecture, engineering and construction as an exquisite physical 3D information sculpture. A small ordered group of ivory document panels, with subtle technical drawing details and table-line marks, flows through a forest-green modular routing system into three clean structured output cards. The paths are fine muted terracotta/copper tracks with restrained round junctions; one glass data module and one short stack of circular ceramic data layers suggest retrieval and processing. One document contains a delicate engineering grid and a small structural detail, giving a clear technical-industry cue without showing a designed building. Make the source-to-processed-output progression intuitively legible visually, with disciplined spacing, not a dense literal flowchart.
Style: premium editorial 3D still life, expertly art-directed physical materials: warm ivory matte paper and ceramic, smoked sage glass, dark forest-green anodized surfaces, small terracotta inlays. Sophisticated, calm, precise, tactile. Professional AI and systems consultancy, not playful SaaS cartoon art.
Composition: portrait 4:5, one cohesive sculptural arrangement in the central 70% of the canvas, three-quarter slightly elevated view. Upper-left source papers, central routing/data structure, lower-right orderly output panels, connected on one seamless warm ivory studio surface. All key objects safely inside 15% margins for both portrait and landscape cropping. Full-bleed warm ivory background #ece9df, softly graded; grounded contact shadows. Soft natural studio lighting, strong material realism and quiet depth.
Palette strictly warm ivory #f5f3eb, forest green #1f4035, sage and muted terracotta #b66449. Companion image to a dark forest-green AI knowledge-system hero artwork.
No readable text, letters, logos, watermark, people, humanoid robots, brains, neon, cyberpunk, cities, houses, architectural beauty shots, or fake screenshot claims. Conceptual AI-generated artwork representing document retrieval and workflow automation, not a real product screenshot.
assets.finalEditPrompt:
